name: Lumbar Pars Stress Reaction / Spondylolysis in Athlete
definition: Stress injury or defect of the pars interarticularis, commonly affecting adolescent/young athletes exposed to repetitive extension and rotation.

redFlags.item: Severe night pain or malignancy features

investigations.principle: Imaging is selected based on age, persistence and clinical suspicion.
investigations.MRI: MRI can detect early stress reaction without radiation.
investigations.radiographs: Radiographs may show established defects; CT defines bony healing when necessary.

green: Relative load reduction from provocative sport
amber: Bracing and surgery are selective, not routine.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Kati/Snayu-Asthi stress phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Stress injury or defect of the pars interarticularis, commonly affecting adolescent/young athletes exposed to repetitive extension and rotation.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for severe/progressive neurological deficit, vascular compromise, infection/systemic illness, major trauma, sphincter change or other listed red flags.
